name: Blink
notes:
With no dash charge, Blink only teleports and deals its own damage.
Teleports you a dodge distance.
The recast spends 1 dash charge, so Blink and dodging share that resource. Blink itself never needs a dash charge. Elemental Affinity never boosts it; spell crit does.

In game (hwp_sor_blink): a 112 px teleport since 2026-10-25 (90, the dodge's, until then: +24%, the user asked for "a little longer"); the full 112 when nothing is in the way, x 0.95 only when a wall cuts it short. It crosses ledges and stairs the dodge can't (its own raycast asks RaycastType::Shot, which ignores the shoot-through rails; the vanilla Teleport's Any ray stopped at them). Effects: a blue vanish at the start, a bead trail along the path, an arrival ring where it lands (players/hwp/specs/effects/blink_*.effect). Pure damage within the radius in game units. With a dash charge it replays the last fire, ice or lightning spell (or the Elemental Orb; Lightning Ball and Flame Step too, not channelled spells) from the start, its whole cost (flat and percentage, as the game charges it) paid down to 1 mana, its cooldown restarted.

2026-10-25 changes (range, ledges, effects) built, not yet run in the lab: scenario fix-specs-arcane (blink_range, blink_ledge).
summary: Teleport a short distance (112 px), over ledges and stairs, dealing Pure damage to every enemy near where you reappear. If you have a dash charge, Blink spends it to recast your last cast elemental spell from your original location, regardless of cooldown or mana cost. It recasts even while that spell is on cooldown or you can't afford it; the cost is still paid, and if you can't afford it the recast leaves you at 1 mana. The recast also restarts that spell's cooldown from the beginning.
